player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin wasan Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Alamarka ita ce '{symbol}'. Manufar ita ce ka guji samun uku a jere (a kwance, a tsaye, ko a kwance). Idan ka yi uku a jere, ka rasa. Aika motarka ta amfani da tsari '[4]' don sanya alamarka a cikin tantanin halitta 4. A matsayin Mai kunnawa {player_id}, kai ne '{symbol}' kuma abokin adawarka shine '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsi mara inganci. Yi amfani da "[cell]".
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} an riga an shagaltar da shi.

game_action.placed: Mai kunnawa {player_id} sanya alamar su ({symbol}) a cikin tantanin halitta {cell} .

outcome.loss: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya rasa ta hanyar kammala layi!
